title: Akiyama Mizuki — What I've Learned〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, the next problem is...
Yikes, reading comprehension... I'm gonna need my Japanese-English dictionary...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They've been making me take so many supplementary classes lately too...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Fortunately, neither the teacher nor anyone else from class is here. That means I can take my time and look at my textbook while I try to solve these...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Still, what's with all these worksheets?
Are they really gonna hold me back if I don't finish all of them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, wait! What if that's just their way of getting me to hit the books...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I should probably just do my best to get through them. Having to repeat a year would be a total drag.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, that's it for English!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That just leaves... Ugh, math...
I hope these problems only need me to plug and chug some formulas.
Huh? Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? Hey, Ena!
Wait, what are you doing here? Night school doesn't start for a while...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was gonna check out this one store before coming here, but they were closed...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You didn't bother to check beforehand?
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Laugh all you want. I can always go tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, why are you here? Supplementary classes? Are you sure they're not gonna make you repeat a year?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nah, I'm actually pretty good at this stuff. In theory, it shouldn't take me too long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If anything, my biggest enemy right now is my motivation level. I'm trying to solve these problems, but they're so boring.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Seriously...?
Shouldn't you be trying a little harder since there's a real possibility of you having to repeat?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I am trying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know...! You're free until classes start, right? You should stay here and study with me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Oh, actually, we do have math today, and I'm probably gonna get called on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's all the more reason to stay and study!
Here, sit next to me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Fine, it's not like I have anything else to do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Mizuki, you're working on math too...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup. Once I wrap up these problems, I'm free from my supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...? Oh, this formula looks kinda familiar. What was it for again?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh?
What happened to you being a year ahead of me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't blame me. All this old stuff keeps getting replaced with new information.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to check over what we're covering in class today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Grr. She totally brushed me off.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nothing. It feels like we're at school is all.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean? We are at school.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know.
Anyway, time to get through these problems!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hm...? That's weird. I thought this formula would give me the answer...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And there's nothing else like it in the textbook...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Ena...?
Is this the right way to solve this problem?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Lemme see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, I have no idea...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hmm... What should I do? This is the only one I can't figure out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why not just ask the teacher?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way. Not after saying that it'd be a piece of cake. That'd be like me admitting defeat.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're kidding, right...?
I mean, you can't go home until you solve that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know...
So, I'll just take a picture of this and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Mafuyu, am I solving this problem the right way?>
And send!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You won't ask your teacher, but you're willing to ask Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, 'cause Mafuyu's Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Uh, okay...? Well, we'll see if she responds before the day ends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right. Mafuyu's always super busy...
I guess that means I should try a little harder to figure this out on my own.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, hey! Mafuyu replied!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! No way! You literally just sent her that text! She figured it out already?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like it!
Check it out! She wrote how to solve it in her notebook and took a picture!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, here's her message.
<You're using the right formula, but putting in the wrong numbers>...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, she's right! That explains why it was spitting out such a weird answer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it only took her a second to figure out. She really is smart...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow, she just totally saved me!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Thanks for helping me solve that! That was actually the last worksheet they were making me do for my supplementary classes! You're a lifesaver, Mafuyu!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It just goes to show that it's always nice to have a senior you can rely on.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? Sorry I'm so unreliable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
Studying with you was so much fun, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Eww. Now you're just being creepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! You meanie!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
